CanonChangesOverTime: Kaelen's brass gauntlet previously pulsed with erratic flickering; it now stands cold and inert.
The air in the city previously tasted of copper and rot; at the watchfort it smells of dry dust, old stone, and woodsmoke.
The silence in the forest was predatory; the silence in the courtyard is merely the absence of noise.
Kaelen's legs were trembling from adrenaline withdrawal; he now sits hunched against a wall.
Elias previously held his sword tightly with numb fingers; he now has sheathed it and sat on a bench.
The party was separated when Elias and Kaelen entered the forest; they are now reunited inside the watchfort gatehouse.
